newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait to launch $82.5 local mutual fund.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait to launch $82.5 local mutual fund.

text.p: The state Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA) will launch a 25 million dinar ($82.5 million) local mutual fund, a newspaper reported on Wednesday.
Al-Qabas newspaper quoted a KIA official as saying the fund will be managed by Kuwait Investment Co (KIC).

"KIA, within the privatisation programme...agreed with KIC to establish and manage a new mutual fund. KIA will sell local shares it owns to the fund at an estimated value of about 25 million dinars at a price lower than market value," he added.

KIA, the state investement arm, is supervising a programme which has sold holdings in more than 20 local firms for 750 million dinars since 1994. The first phase will involve another 18 local firms worth one billion dinars over the next two years.
